content.value: There is a single heap of coins. Two players, Max(first player) and Min(second player), play alternately. On each turn, a player selects a heap of size $n \geq 3$ and splits it into two unequal positive integer heaps, i.e.,

$$
n \to i + ( n - i ) , { \mathrm { ~ w h e r e ~ } } i \neq ( n - i )
$$

The game ends when no valid split is possible. The player who cannot move loses. Apply the Minimax algorithm to the initial state consisting of a single heap of 7 coins, and determine whether any optimal move is available for the Max player by showing the complete game tree.
